programs.title: The Housewives of the North Pole
programs.desc: Friends Trish and Diana (Betsy Brandt) win the competition for the best Christmas home decoration every year.When they break off the relationship after a quarrel, they take part in the struggle as rivals.

programs.title: How to Train Your Dragon: The Hidden World
programs.desc: A grave danger looms over Berk.The unexpected appearance of a wild and elusive dragon coincides with the darkest period in the history of the settlement.Toothless loses his head for a beautiful creature.However, he does not realize that it hides a dangerous secret.She is followed by someone who intends to trap all the dragons.The enemy threatens the inhabitants of a land where flying creatures and people live in harmony with each other.The young Viking Hiccup and his friend set off on an adventurous journey.Daredevils search for the hidden world of legends.During the expedition, two different races unite to fight for what is most precious to them.The last part of the film trilogy based on the books by Cressida Cowell.In the Polish language version, the characters were voiced by, among others:Grzegorz Drojewski, Julia Kamińska, Wojciech Machnicki, Sebastian Cybulski and Tomasz Traczyński.

programs.title: Mountainhead
programs.desc: While a massive financial crisis is brewing around the world, billionaire Souper (Jason Schwartzman) invites three friends as rich as him - Randall (Steve Carell), Venis (Cory Michael Smith) and Jeff (Ramy Youssef) - to his spacious villa in the mountains.Their combined fortunes are worth $371 billion, but their guilt for the situation is zero.The men spend their time carefree, drinking alcohol and joking, as well as ironically commenting on suspicious scenes of street riots on TV or on the Internet.The feature-length directorial debut of Jesse Armstrong, the creator of "Succession" and seven-time Emmy winner.

programs.title: Avenue of the Giants
programs.desc: California.For years, 74-year-old Herbert Heller hid from his family his traumatic experiences during World War II and his stay in the Auschwitz-Birkenau camp, where he was sent at the age of twelve, and three years later he attempted to escape.All this changes when he meets Abbey (Fisher), rejected by his peers, whose own difficult experiences prompt him to open up.A moving, healing friendship develops between a man and a teenager.The story is based on the true memories of Herbert Heller, a former concentration camp prisoner who settled in the USA after the war.

programs.title: A Royal Christmas Holiday
programs.desc: A reporter interviews the prince.They fall in love with each other at first sight.

programs.title: Soul On Fire
programs.desc: Nine-year-old John O'Leary suffers burns to almost his entire body.He struggles with pain and limitations.However, he wins love and makes his dreams come true.He inspires others by showing how to live life to the fullest.

programs.title: Eine Million Minuten
programs.desc: Spouses Vera (Karoline Herfurth) and Wolf (Tom Schilling) Küper, parents of Nina (Pola Friedrichs) and Simon (Piet Levi Busch), have difficulty dividing their time between work and household duties.The bond that united them years ago is weakening.Wolf focuses on his professional career, and Vera, confined to her four walls, is fed up with loneliness and having to replace her children's fathers.The family's world is ruined by the daughter's disastrous medical diagnosis.Wolf recalls that the girl's greatest wish was to spend a million minutes solely on pleasure.The Küpers decide to make her dream come true.Together they set off on a lifelong journey that leads through exotic regions of the world.They get to know new places and foreign cultures, and decide what their future will look like.

programs.title: Materialists
programs.desc: Lucy (Dakota Johnson), an employee of a luxury dating agency, measures her professional success by having nine arranged marriages.Together with her colleagues, she recruits clients based on their market value, which is determined by financial status, education and age.She follows a similar logic herself.She ended her five-year relationship because her boyfriend John (Chris Evans) had too little income.Now she is single and waiting for a rich man whom she will quickly marry.Fate sends her Harry (Pedro Pascal), the owner of an apartment worth... 12 million dollars.A relationship with him, even without love, becomes a beneficial investment for her and a guarantee of a high standard of living.But then John appears on the horizon again and, against her better judgment, Lucy begins to have doubts...

programs.title: Euphoria
programs.desc: The further fate of a group of friends who left school behind and entered adulthood.The action moves forward several years.Rue (Zendaya Coleman) is no longer a lost teenager, but a person involved in the criminal world.He goes to interrogation in connection with smuggling drugs from Mexico.Cassie (Sydney Sweeney) and Maddy's (Alexa Demie) relationship has improved, but old wounds haven't healed at all.The first woman's relationship with Nate (Jacob Elordi) develops, but not towards a happy ending.The remaining characters confront their own choices, addiction and violence.They are looking for redemption and answers to the question about their place in the world.

programs.title: Closer
programs.desc: London.Stripper and waitress Alice (Natalie Portman) has a minor accident on the street.Writer Dan (Jude Law) takes her to the hospital.They fall in love with each other almost at first sight and move in together.A few months later, Dan falls in love with talented photographer Anna (Julia Roberts).Although she is not indifferent to the writer, knowing about his relationship with Alice, she does not want to meet him.To take revenge, Dan impersonates her in one of the erotic chat rooms and starts a spicy conversation with doctor Larry (Clive Owen).The first real meeting between Larry and Anna is quite unfortunate, but soon they both fall in love and get married.After some time, the woman meets Dan again and the old fascination is revived.Meanwhile, Larry meets Alice and falls under her spell.Adapted from a play by Patrick Marber.Clive Owen and Natalie Portman received Golden Globe and Oscar nominations.

programs.title: Blink Twice
programs.desc: At a charity event, waitress Frida (Naomi Ackie) meets billionaire tech mogul Slater King (Channing Tatum).Together with her friend Jess (Alia Shawkat), she accepts his invitation to a private island.On site are Slater's friends and business partners: photographer Vic (Christian Slater), private chef Cody (Simon Rex), DJ Tom (Haley Joel Osment), college graduate Lucas (Levon Hawke), reality star Sarah (Adria Arjona), aspiring app creator Camilla (Liz Caribel) and lawyer Heather (Trew Mullen).A holiday stay means crazy nights interspersed with sunny days.All the guests are having a great time.Until then.Mysterious events occur that make Frida grow anxious.She will have to find the truth to save her life.

programs.title: The Alabama Solution
programs.desc: Andrew Jarecki and Charlotte Kaufman present the results of a 6-year investigation into an Alabama prison.They expose systemic abuses of power and human rights violations.
